title: Nostr-native relay settings UI and NIP-86 management interface
intended_behavior: Operators can add and remove persistent Bahia relay policy from Settings without confusing it with local browser-session relay overrides.
Relay policy mutations use ContextVM kind 25910 methods instead of REST or localStorage-only persistence.
Accepted mutations publish service-signed canonical relay settings state kind 30900 and audit kind 4903.
NIP-86 relay administration is exposed only through Bahia ContextVM validation and only for configured Bahia-owned or Bahia-authorized targets.
protocol_constraints: Do not introduce new relay-routing event kinds.
ContextVM responses are acknowledgments; durable truth is canonical observable state.
NIP-86 remains relay-owner HTTP administration protected by NIP-98, not Bahia application mutation transport.
Local browser relay overrides remain local and are labelled as non-persistent operator policy.
